```{r load_dependencies}
# Load required packages
if (!require(pacman)) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(here,
               data.table,
               dplyr,
               tidyr,
               gtsummary,
               grid,

# Load helper functions
source(here("R", "2-analysis", "utils_analysis.R"))
```

```{r}
# Initialise filenames
swl_qced_phenotypes_filename <- "swl_qced_phenotypes.csv"
raine_qced_phenotypes_filename <- "raine_qced_phenotypes.csv"

swl_demographics_filename <- "swl_demographics.csv"
raine_demographics_filename <- "raine_demographics.csv"

# Create output directories if they don't exist
invisible(lapply(c(
  here("output", "prepared", "tables"),
  here("output", "prepared", "figures")
), dir.create, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE))
```

# Load data

```{r}
# Load physical activity data
dat_swl_qced <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_qced_phenotypes_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

dat_raine_qced <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_qced_phenotypes_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Load demographics data
swl_demographics <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", swl_demographics_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

raine_demographics <- data.table::fread(
  here("output", "intermediate", raine_demographics_filename),
  data.table = FALSE
)

# Convert MVPA from hours to mins
dat_swl_qced <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))

dat_raine_qced <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  mutate(across(starts_with("mvpa"), ~ .x * 60))

# Convert wear time from total hours to daily hours
dat_swl_qced   <- add_daily_wear(dat_swl_qced)
dat_raine_qced <- add_daily_wear(dat_raine_qced)
```

# Main Tables

## Table 1: Participant characteristics

```{r}
# Left-join from QCed participant list so every QCed participant has a row,
# even if absent from the demographics file (missing demographics → NA)
demo_cols <- c("age", "sex", "employment", "education",
               "bmi_3gp", "prevalent_cvd")  

swl_demographics <- dat_swl_qced %>%
  select(pid) %>%
  left_join(swl_demographics, by = "pid") %>%
  select(all_of(demo_cols)) %>%
  mutate(study = "SMART Work & Life")

raine_demographics <- dat_raine_qced %>%
  select(pid) %>%
  left_join(raine_demographics, by = "pid") %>%
  select(all_of(demo_cols)) %>%
  mutate(study = "Raine Study Gen1")

combined_demographics <- bind_rows(swl_demographics, raine_demographics) %>%
  mutate(sex = factor(sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
         education = factor(education, 
                            levels = c("No education",
                                       "Basic education",
                                       "Further education",
                                       "University degree")),
         employment = factor(employment,
                             levels = c("Not employed", "Student", "Employed")),
         bmi_3gp = factor(bmi_3gp, 
                          levels = c("<24.9", "25-29.9", "30+")),
         prevalent_cvd = factor(prevalent_cvd, 
                                levels = c("No", "Yes")),
         study = factor(study, 
                        levels = c("SMART Work & Life", "Raine Study Gen1")))

# Convert NA to "Missing" category
combined_demographics <- convert_na_to_missing(combined_demographics,
                                               c("sex",
                                                 "education",
                                                 "employment",
                                                 "bmi_3gp",
                                                 "prevalent_cvd"))

# Prep labels for Table 1
row_labels <- list(age = "Age (years)",
                   sex = "Sex",
                   education = "Education",
                   employment = "Employment status",
                   bmi_3gp = "Body mass index (kg/m2)",
                   prevalent_cvd = "Prevalent CVD")

# Build table 1 by study
table1 <- combined_demographics %>%
  tbl_summary(by = study,
              label = row_labels,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                               all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
              digits = list(age ~ 1),
              missing = "no") %>%
  modify_spanning_header(all_stat_cols() ~ "**Study**") %>%
  remove_footnote_header() %>%
  bold_labels()

table1

# Save Table 1 to .docx
table1 %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::gtsave(here("output", "prepared", "tables", "Table_1.docx"))
```

## Table 2: Descriptive statistics of accelerometer-derived phenotypes

```{r}
# Define phenotype columns/rows and labels
pa_rows <- c("overall_activity", 
             "steps", 
             "cadence_peak1",
             "mvpa", 
             "lipa", 
             "sedentary")

pa_labels <- list(overall_activity = "Overall activity (mg/day)",
                  steps            = "Step count (steps/day)",
                  cadence_peak1    = "Peak 1-min cadence (steps/minute)",
                  mvpa             = "MVPA (minutes/day)",
                  lipa             = "Light physical activity (hours/day)",
                  sedentary        = "Sedentary behaviour (hours/day)",
                  daily_wear_time_hours  = "Wear time (hours/day)")

cols <- c("SWL_wrist", "SWL_thigh", "Raine_wrist", "Raine_hip")

col_labels <- c(label = "**Phenotype**",
                SWL_wrist = "**SWL (wrist)**",
                SWL_thigh = "**SWL (thigh)**",
                Raine_wrist = "**Raine Study Gen1 (wrist)**",
                Raine_hip = "**Raine Study Gen1 (hip)**")

# Combine SWL and Raine datasets in wide format
swl_wide   <- prep_wide(dat_swl_qced,  "SWL")
raine_wide <- prep_wide(dat_raine_qced, "Raine")

combined_wide <- bind_rows(swl_wide, raine_wide) %>%
  select(study_wear_location, all_of(c("daily_wear_time_hours", pa_rows))) %>%
  mutate(study_wear_location = factor(study_wear_location, levels = cols),
         across(all_of(all_of(c("daily_wear_time_hours", pa_rows))), as.numeric))

# Build summary table
table_2 <- combined_wide %>%
  tbl_summary(by = study_wear_location,
              statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                               mvpa ~ "{median} ({p25}–{p75})",
                               daily_wear_time_hours ~ "{median} ({p25}–{p75})"),
              label = pa_labels,
              digits = list(all_continuous() ~ 1,
                            steps ~ 0,
                            mvpa ~ 0),
              missing = "no")

# Apply clean column labels in correct order
table_2 <- table_2 %>%
  modify_header(label ~ col_labels["label"],
                stat_1 ~ col_labels["SWL_wrist"],
                stat_2 ~ col_labels["SWL_thigh"],
                stat_3 ~ col_labels["Raine_wrist"],
                stat_4 ~ col_labels["Raine_hip"]) %>%
  modify_footnote(everything() ~ NA) %>%
  bold_labels()

table_2

# Save Table 2 to .docx
table_2 %>%
  as_gt() %>%
  gt::gtsave(here("output", "prepared", "tables", "Table_2.docx"))
```

```{r}

gap       <- 0.04   # relative gap between panels A and B

# Prepare individual scatter plots for SWL

                           phenotype = 'overall_activity_mean', 
                           title = 'Overall activity',
                           phenotype_units = 'mg/day',
                           axes_lims = c(0, 60))

                           phenotype = 'steps_mean', 
                           title = 'Step count',
                           phenotype_units = 'steps/day',
                           axes_lims = c(0, 30000))

plot3 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_swl_qced, 
                           phenotype = 'cadence_peak1_mean', 
                           title = 'Peak 1-min cadence',
                           phenotype_units = 'steps/minute',
                           axes_lims = c(60, 180))

plot4 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_swl_qced, 
                           phenotype = 'mvpa_mean',

                           phenotype_units = 'minutes/day',
                           skewed_phenotype = TRUE,

plot5 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_swl_qced, 
                           phenotype = 'lipa_mean', 
                           title = 'Light physical activity',
                           phenotype_units = 'hours/day',

plot6 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_swl_qced,

plot3 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced,

                           phenotype_units = 'minutes/day',

plot6 <- make_scatter_plot(dat_raine_qced,
```

# Supplementary Figures

## Figure S2: Absolute agreement ICCs

```{r}
swl_icc_df <- map_dfr(pa_rows, function(pheno) {
  icc_swl <- calculate_icc(
    df   = dat_swl_qced,
    col1 = paste0(pheno, "_mean_wrist"),
    col2 = paste0(pheno, "_mean_thigh"),
    fmt_sep = ","
  )

  tibble(
    phenotype = pheno,
    est = icc_swl$icc_est,
    lci = icc_swl$icc_lci,
    uci = icc_swl$icc_uci
  )
})

raine_icc_df <- map_dfr(pa_rows, function(pheno) {
  icc_raine <- calculate_icc(
    df   = dat_raine_qced,
    col1 = paste0(pheno, "_mean_wrist"),
    col2 = paste0(pheno, "_mean_hip"),
    fmt_sep = ","
  )

  tibble(
    phenotype = pheno,
    est = icc_raine$icc_est,
    lci = icc_raine$icc_lci,
    uci = icc_raine$icc_uci
  )
})

vlines <- list(
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0.75,
                      linetype = "dashed",
                      colour = "black",
                      linewidth = 0.4)

)

forestplot_labels <- data.frame(
  phenotype = pa_rows,
  label = unname(unlist(pa_labels[pa_rows]))
)

figure <- ckbplotr::forest_plot(
  list ("SMART Work & Life (wrist vs. thigh)" = swl_icc_df, "Raine Study Gen1 (wrist vs. hip)" = raine_icc_df),
  row.labels = forestplot_labels,
  col.key = "phenotype",
  col.estimate = "est",
  col.lci = "lci",
  col.uci = "uci",
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  xlim = c(0, 1),
  xticks = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1),
  xlab = c("ICC"),
  right.heading = "ICC (95% CI)",
  panel.width = unit(50, "mm"),
  base_size = 10,
  add = list(start = vlines)
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "prepared", "figures", "Figure_S2.png"),
  plot = figure$plot,
  width = 23,
  height = 8,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Figure S4: Equivalence tests

```{r}
eq_zone <- 0.1

equi_test_swl_list <- list()
equi_test_raine_list <- list()

for (pheno in pa_rows) {

  res_swl <- equivalence_test(dat_swl_qced, paste0(pheno, "_mean"), eq_zone)
  res_raine <- equivalence_test(dat_raine_qced, paste0(pheno, "_mean"), eq_zone)

  equi_test_swl_list[[pheno]] <- data.frame(
    phenotype = pheno,
    mean_ratio = res_swl$mean_ratio,
    lci = res_swl$lci,
    uci = res_swl$uci,
    is_equivalent = res_swl$is_equivalent
  )

  equi_test_raine_list[[pheno]] <- data.frame(
    phenotype = pheno,
    mean_ratio = res_raine$mean_ratio,
    lci = res_raine$lci,
    uci = res_raine$uci,
    is_equivalent = res_raine$is_equivalent
  )
}

equi_test_swl <- do.call(rbind, equi_test_swl_list)
equi_test_raine <- do.call(rbind, equi_test_raine_list)

row.names(equi_test_swl) <- NULL
row.names(equi_test_raine) <- NULL

vlines <- list(
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1 - eq_zone,
                      linetype = "dashed",
                      colour = "black",
                      linewidth = 0.4),
  ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 1 + eq_zone,
                      linetype = "dashed",
                      colour = "black",
                      linewidth = 0.4)
)

forestplot_labels <- data.frame(
  phenotype = pa_rows,
  label = unname(unlist(pa_labels[pa_rows]))
)

figure <- ckbplotr::forest_plot(
  list ("SMART Work & Life (wrist vs. thigh)" = equi_test_swl, "Raine Study Gen1 (wrist vs. hip)" = equi_test_raine),
  row.labels = forestplot_labels,
  col.key = "phenotype",
  col.estimate = "mean_ratio",
  col.lci = "lci",
  col.uci = "uci",
  exponentiate = FALSE,
  xlim = c(0.80, 1.20),
  xlab = c("Mean ratio (Thigh/Wrist)", "Mean ratio (Hip/Wrist)"),
  right.heading = "Mean ratio (90% CI)",
  nullval = TRUE,
  panel.width = unit(50, "mm"),
  base_size = 10,
  left.gap = c("I", "I"),
  add = list(start = vlines)
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("output", "prepared", "figures", "Figure_S4.png"),
  plot = figure$plot,
  width = 23,
  height = 8,
  units = "cm",
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

```{r}
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

panel_b <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(
  panel_b,
  top = grid::textGrob(
    "B. Raine Study Gen1 (wrist vs. hip)",
    x = 0.02,
    y = 0.98,
    just = c("left", "top"),
    gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 14, fontface = "bold")
  )
)

# Add black borders around each panel
panel_a <- grid::grobTree(
  panel_a,
  grid::rectGrob(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    width  = unit(1, "npc") + unit(inner_pad, "npc"),
    height = unit(1, "npc") + unit(inner_pad, "npc"),
    gp = grid::gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 1)
  )
)

panel_b <- grid::grobTree(
  panel_b,
  grid::rectGrob(
    x = 0.5,
    y = 0.5,
    width  = unit(1, "npc") + unit(inner_pad, "npc"),
    height = unit(1, "npc") + unit(inner_pad, "npc"),
    gp = grid::gpar(fill = NA, col = "black", lwd = 1)
  )
)

# Stack the two boxed panels
figure <- gridExtra::arrangeGrob(panel_a,
                                 grid::nullGrob(),
                                 panel_b,
                                 ncol = 1,
                                 heights = c(1, gap, 1))

# Add small outer margin
figure <- ggplot() +
  theme_void() +
  annotation_custom(figure) +
  theme(plot.margin = grid::unit(c(0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5), "cm"))

# Save figure to file
ggsave(filename = here("output", "prepared", "figures", "Figure_S5.png"),
       plot = figure,
       width = 16,
       height = 20,
       units = "cm",
       dpi = 300,
       bg = "white")
```

```{r}
# Prepare phenotype columns

 corr_res <- calculate_corr(

   "overall_activity_counts_mean_hip"
 )

# Prepare plot
```
